MEET THE ARTIST / 정밀아

JEONGMILLA

JEONGMILLA is a folk singer-songwriter who writes about her life by paying attention to the places around her. On CheongPa Sonata, that means the streets, neighbours and public squares within walking distance of home.

BY INDIEK / UPDATED 2026-11-11

Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓
SONG PAGESDeparting from Seoul Station ↗Flower ↗

She released her first two studio albums in 2014 and 2017, followed by her third, CheongPa Sonata, in 2020. She studied art at university and continues to make visual art alongside music.

FOLK / 2020

Departing from Seoul Station서울역에서 출발

Official music video

View release on Apple Music ↗

A conversation with her mother turns Seoul Station into a way of looking back at the speaker’s life: arriving for a university entrance exam, expecting to become a painter and finding a living in music. JEONGMILLA wrote the words and music.

Lyrics by JEONGMILLA; music by JEONGMILLA; arranged by JEONGMILLA.

FOLK / 2016

Flower꽃

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Flower” addresses someone whose worth needs no proof through beauty, achievement or possessions. Na Tae-joo wrote the words, and JEONGMILLA composed and arranged the song.

A little background

Bugs lists this recording on the single 꽃 and credits JEONGMILLA as its vocalist, composer and arranger, with lyrics by Na Tae-joo. The linked performance is a live video from her own channel.

Lyrics by Na Tae-joo; music by JEONGMILLA; arranged by JEONGMILLA.

Live performance · 03:45
